name: last
description: last(1) reads /etc/wtmp and lists sessions most recent first. At the boot prompt the log holds exactly two records init and login(3) wrote: a `~'/reboot boot record and the root/console login that is still open. So last prints the console session as `still logged in', the reboot line below it, and the `wtmp begins' trailer stamped with the oldest record. Proves the whole W1+W2 chain end to end: init's boot record, login(3)'s wtmp append, the 36-byte record layout, and last's backwards block walk + ctime/gmtime formatting over it.
